author: Dry2Ice
description: Archives chat history into a validated chronological record using the real Date/Time/Location headers when the chat template provides them, keeps the last N messages raw and excludes the absorbed ones from the prompt with SillyTavern's own flag (they stay readable in the chat), maintains a per-chat summary of character and plot state that can be hand-edited, and builds a lorebook. Token-budgeted against the real context window, with per-request retries and manual cancellation.
